text:
marie: Quick ask — launching next Tuesday. Can we confirm the JSON-LD snippet + internal linking plan for the launch post + webinar landing? Need redirects list too. TL;DR: landing must pass Rich Results, CTA links to pricing, webinar signup should be canonical. Anyone free for a quick sync?

sam: On it. I can draft Product + Event JSON-LD and an internal-link map. Do we have target keywords for the launch copy?

marie: Primary = "inference platform"; secondary = "low-latency LLM serving" and "dedicated GPU inference". Tone = technical but customer-focused.

ana: I’ll update the internal-link spreadsheet and add anchors for each pillar. Suggest 3 priority pillars to link to: Performance, Cost, Privacy/Isolation. Also will add anchor IDs for deep links into the long-form launch post.

devon: From infra/engineering: we need redirects ready before the launch deploys. Current candidates: `/pricing-beta` -> `/pricing`, `/docs/serve` -> `/docs/inference-serving`, `/launch-old` -> `/launch`. I’ll need the final list and a suggested low-traffic window for 301s.

matt: Webinar landing needs Event schema (startDate, location/online, offers). Also add `sameAs` for speakers and a Google Calendar + Zoom link. A/B test two H1s: technical vs value-led. :rocket:

sam: Draft JSON-LD (Product + Event) — can we use this as the base? Feel free to tweak.

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@graph": [
    {
      "@type": "Product",
      "name": "Redwood Inference",
      "description": "High-performance LLM inference platform for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.",
      "brand": "Redwood Inference",
      "offers": {
        "@type": "Offer",
        "priceCurrency": "USD",
        "url": "https://redwood.ai/pricing"
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Event",
      "name": "Redwood Inference Launch Webinar",
      "startDate": "2026-04-02T10:00:00Z",
      "eventAttendanceMode": "https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode",
      "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
      "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar/launch",
      "offers": {
        "@type": "Offer",
        "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar/launch/register",
        "price": "0",
        "priceCurrency": "USD"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

sam: Notes: include `mainEntityOfPage` on the launch post pointing to the Product JSON-LD, ensure `image` fields use fully qualified URLs, and add `author`/`publisher` for trust signals. Use `eventAttendanceMode`=Online for the webinar.

ana: Anchor + internal link map (draft):
- /launch#performance -> links to /docs/inference-serving/performance (anchor: #batching)
- /launch#cost -> links to /pricing (anchor: #reserved-capacity)
- /launch#privacy -> links to /security/compliance (anchor: #vpc-private)

sam: Redirect checklist (suggested):
- 301 /pricing-beta -> /pricing
- 301 /docs/serve -> /docs/inference-serving
- 301 /launch-old -> /launch
- 301 /webinar-old -> /webinar/launch
- update sitemap.xml and ping Search Console for reindexing

devon: I’ll schedule the redirects for Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC (low traffic) after the final sheet is live. Please add a notes column with `reason` and `backup_url`.

matt: Campaign UTMs for links: `utm_source=launch_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=launch_wk1_prd` and `launch_wk1_webinar` for the webinar CTA. Keep them consistent across social assets.

marie: Solid. Sam — can you post the final JSON-LD + small copy edits by EOD so ana can drop anchors into the CMS and devon can queue redirects? We’ll run Lighthouse (mobile + desktop) and check Rich Results in Search Console tomorrow morning.

sam: Yup — posting final JSON-LD and a tiny sample anchor map in the doc now. Also adding a quick QA checklist: 1) valid JSON-LD (structured data testing), 2) meta description <=160 chars, 3) canonical tags present, 4) rel=prev/next for paginated sections, 5) internal links use absolute URLs for cross-subdomain.

ana: Sheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/LAUNCH-SEO-ANCHORS (I'll share edit access). I’ll ping eng when it’s ready.

devon: Thx — once shared I’ll create a deploy ticket and schedule the 301s. Please add a smoke test list for the redirects (old url -> should 200 -> final url).

matt: Quick win: include `FAQPage` schema on the launch post with 3 top questions (performance, pricing, privacy). That helps for SERP real estate.

marie: Love it. Final owners: Sam (schema + copy edits), Ana (anchors + link map), Devon (redirects + deploy), Matt (webinar schema + UTMs). I’ll coordinate exec comms. :thumbsup:

seo-bot: Reminder scheduled: Run Rich Results test and Lighthouse tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

marie: Thanks all — will follow up after EOD publish.
